title: Pre-Sales Technical Specialist, ACI Growth
jobDescription:
Job Title Pre-Sales Technical Specialist, ACI Growth Job Description In this position, you will provide pre-sales technical leadership for the Philips Capsule Medical Device Information (MDI), Intelli Bridge Enterprise (IBE), Intelli Space Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA), e Care Manager (e CM), and Clinical Insight Manager (CIM) product lines, supporting growth across India, APAC, and META. Minimum required

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's/master’s degree in computer science or a health science, or equivalent. Minimum required Experience: Minimum of 4 years of experience working within a commercial capacity in the Healthcare Technology, Healthcare Analytics, or Information Technology area. Your

ROLE:
Act as the primary technical expert for ACI products, with a focus on Capsule MDI, in assigned regions during presales engagements and supporting the sales team with any technical support. Own solution architecture design, sizing, assumptions and technical risk identification for opportunities. Actively participate in documentation during the pre-sales process, such as Solution Design Documents (SDD), Solution Architectures, and Statements of Work. Take ownership and provide feedback on pre-sales artifacts, including document repositories, demonstrations, proof-of-concept (POC) environments and bundles. Maintain knowledge of market trends, healthcare interoperability standards, competitive offerings and industry best practices. Support competitive analysis activities and provide technical differentiation against competitor solutions. Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution walkthroughs, site assessments and demonstrations with customers and partners. Define end-to-end data flows from bedside devices via the Capsule MDIP to third-party solutions, such as CIS and EMR systems. Provide pre-sales expertise across: Capsule MDI platform, including device integrations IBE/Interoperability (HL7, ADT/ORU, downstream systems) Intelli Space Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA) e Care Manager (e CM) Clinical Insights Manager (CIM) While also supporting other products within the ACI portfolio Conduct detailed workflow assessments, device connectivity assessments and technical site surveys to validate solution feasibility and implementation assumptions. Ensure alignment with hospital IT organisations across security, networking, infrastructure and availability requirements. Participate in handover to delivery (HTD) to ensure clarity and solution intent, including assisting implementation and delivery when necessary. Contribute to deal governance, risk reviews, and internal approvals for any sales opportunities. Be the subject matter expert (SME) for Capsule MDI across META and India. Additional responsibilities for providing pre-sales expertise for the Intelli Bridge Enterprise and Clinical Insight Manager. Ability and willingness to travel across India, META and APAC markets as required to support customer engagements, workshops and demonstrations. You’re the right fit if You have hands-on experience supporting, designing, implementing, or selling healthcare software solutions such as Clinical Information Systems (CIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), Medical Device Integration platforms, interoperability solutions, or clinical analytics platforms. You have experience presenting, designing, influencing and advising customers on complex technical solutions throughout the sales lifecycle, from discovery and qualification through solution design, proposal development and technical validation. You have a strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms, cybersecurity principles, healthcare interoperability and integration technologies, including HL7, FHIR, APIs, SQL, XML/JSON, ADT/ORM/ORU workflows. You are an effective communicator who can clearly articulate both technical concepts and business value to clinical, technical, and executive stakeholders. You are self-motivated, adaptable and collaborative, with a willingness to learn, embrace new challenges, work across multiple cultures and geographies, and contribute to a high-performing regional team. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations. Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role. title: Global Product Manager (Sleep Therapy)
jobDescription:
Job Title Global Product Manager (Sleep Therapy) Job Description In this role, you will lead partnership strategy and legacy portfolio lifecycle management within the Sleep and Diagnostics Segment. You will drive the commercial success of products brought to market through strategic partnerships — owning go-to-market planning, business case development, and launch performance — while also ensuring the legacy portfolio continues to meet customer needs through service excellence and smart portfolio optimization. You will work closely with cross-functional product management, R&D, and commercial teams, and report to the Segment Leader, Sleep and Diagnostics Therapies. This role is based in Pune, India, co-located with our R&D and cross-functional execution teams. Your

ROLE:
Partnership & Go-to-Market Strategy: Lead go-to-market planning for products developed through strategic partnerships, collaborating with regional market teams to align pricing, volumes, positioning, and launch sequencing that maximize commercial impact. Business Case & Market Alignment: Develop and own business cases for partnership-driven launches, securing alignment and sign-off with markets on investment, pricing strategy, and volume commitments to ensure mutual accountability and commercial readiness. Launch Execution & Performance Management: Support regional teams in executing local launch plans and own the performance management cadence post-launch — tracking adoption, identifying gaps, and driving corrective actions to deliver on committed targets. Legacy Portfolio & Customer Support: Serve as the product management lead for the legacy portfolio, ensuring ongoing customer-facing needs are met with a focus on service continuity, support readiness, and a positive end-of-life experience for customers and patients. Portfolio Optimization: Continuously evaluate the legacy portfolio to identify rationalization and pruning opportunities that simplify the offering, reduce complexity, and identify opportunities to shift focus to growth — while managing transitions in a way that protects customer trust and market position. You're the right fit if: Bachelor's/ master’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management or equivalent. 8+ Years of overall experience in industry working in similar domain and environment. A highly motivated and positive-minded individual with a passion for improving lives. 3+ years of prior experience in product development and management. Knowledge of marketing processes, strategic planning, and budgeting. Exposure to Regulatory frameworks (FDA, EU MDR) and Reimbursement considerations Ability to network and influence in a global organization. Comfortable working across cultures. Strong decision-making skills based on market and customer feedback. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills Willingness to travel up to 10% domestically and globally. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. This role is part of our office‑based team, requiring in‑person collaboration at least three days per week in office. It is critical to have good governance to enforce robust Identity and access management across multiple channels, including mobile, social and cloud. Ability to find existing (legacy) code a positive challenge. Ability to think in risks for the proposed solution (including where to solve it) Design and implementation of software (on component or module level)—understand and communicate consequences of your design on the architecture and influence design specification. jobDescription:

to achieve critical KPIs for quality and productivity targets that are tied to the annual business plans. · Holds reviews with internal and external stakeholders, including business groups, to review plans, strategy and actual metrics for the products. · Manages the business case and is a business partner focused on maximization of the added value for the business and savings potential · Manages projects ensuring execution is in line with project guidelines and directives · Determines project risks, defines corrective action and drives the projects to closure · Determines, allocates, and regulatory agencies policies/rules/procedures · X- functional alignment of Phase in / Phase out planning · Manage E2E project execution as assigned by the functional manager You're the right fit if: · Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or equivalent · 6+ years’ experience in a high-tech industry with a focus on electrical/electronics engineering design · Good exp working in Power BI, Power Apps, AI & Analytics · Experience in design/development of electrical/electronic and understanding of the Embedded system development life cycle · Successful track record of project management and the ability to lead teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders, preferred · Familiarity with PM tools like MS Project, Smartsheets, Power BI · Should be hands-on with jobDescription:
Job Title Outbound / EXIM Executive Job Description Job Location
- Chakan , Pune This exciting role offers a strong opportunity for an experienced Import & Export Operations professional. You will be at the core of DI Systems, responsible for executing import and export operation plans in the ERP system to ensure on‑time material availability from ports to the production line. In this role, you will also drive continuous improvement by initiating and supporting projects aimed at enhancing the overall import and export process. Heath Systems plays a critical role within Philips, delivering advanced solutions that help healthcare professionals meet the needs of patients worldwide. Your

ROLE:
Import & Export Operations Plan and implement import/export strategies aligned with organizational goals. Create and manage shipping documents in SAP or other systems to support timely outbound shipments. Coordinate with Customs House Agents to ensure on‑time clearances and cost‑effective transportation solutions. Interface with shipping lines and freight forwarders for vessel selection, rate negotiation, and damage‑free transit. Handle preparation and maintenance of all import/export documents in line with governing rules and regulations. Manage export and merchant trade activities, ensuring smooth supply chain coordination. Experienced in handling break‑bulk, project cargo, and dangerous goods. Health, Safety & Compliance Foster a work environment that continuously improves employee Health & Safety, including identifying and managing occupational risks and ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations. Ensure adherence to local, country, and international laws governing movement of products, equipment, and materials. Maintain knowledge of import/export accounting requirements and audit compliance. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Work closely with Planning, Warehouse/Factory Operations, Customer Service, and Sales to ensure effective delivery execution and stakeholder visibility. Liaise with internal and external partners—including customs brokers, freight forwarders, and transport vendors—to ensure IMPEX operational excellence. SAP Cadence Update / Maintain import export related Master data in SAP Compliance Eway Bill Processing DG Goods Handling and 360 Reporting Correct HSN declared in customs Daily 6s Review and Maintenance Participate in internal & external audit meet the compliance requirement Actively participate & motivate team for Kaizen initiative FEMA documentation part for non-confirming material No. Critical finding in ISO , EMS , EHS , PH & FDA audits You are a part of the Order-To-Cash process entails all the activities from receipt of customer order to delivery at hospital site. Within the Order-To-Cash process there are 5 key activities handled by 5 teams, namely: S&OP/Order desk, Planning & Execution Control, NPI Supply Chain Management, Operational Procurement and Physical Distribution. You will be part of the warehousing & Logistics team managing a team of more than 5 contract workers. You are the right fit if you have: Education & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree with 3–6 years of experience in import and export operations, preferably within the medical devices or healthcare industry. Communication & Stakeholder Management
- Strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills; able to collaborate effectively across functions and geographies. Technical Competencies
- Demonstrated proficiency in Master Data Management (MDM) and stakeholder coordination to ensure smooth operational execution. Behavioral Strengths
- You bring a customer‑focused mindset, work well in teams, and show a proactive, make‑it‑happen attitude. You are flexible, persistent, empathetic, and skilled at building bridges across organizational levels. Language Skills
- Able to communicate fluently and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing, across various organizational levels. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Data and Software Application Engineer
jobDescription: Job Title Data and Software Application Engineer Job Description Job Titlle : Data and Software Application Engineer In this role, you develop and maintain software applications for Philips Service Parts Supply Chain (SPS), including workflow applications, process automations, Control Towers and Artificial Intelligence implementations which span over all SPS functions, such as Supply Management, Forward Supply Chain, Reverse Supply Chain, Planning, Parts Lifecycle Management, Customer Order Fulfilment, Parts Quality, etc. You are responsible for Maintaining existing SPS database & software applications. Designing and developing new software applications in collaboration with business process owners and experts, subject matter experts, IT and other partners to enhance customer experience and ensure operational excellence while safeguarding SPS processes. Ensuring SPS software applications are documented and well understood by key stakeholders. Securing the right software quality by supporting (and participating in) the execution of the software validation process as required. Acting as a point of contact for questions regarding the SPS software applications at the business level. Leading or contributing to incident resolutions and issue resolutions regarding the SPS software applications. Supporting business in clean-up following incident resolution. Supporting business and IT by sharing knowledge, experience and perspective. Contributing to a data and digital platform architecture that enables integration with existing applications and extensions with new technologies, especially with AI. You are a part of Philips Circular Lifetime Solutions organization Service Parts Supply Chain group Supply Chain Architecture team Service Parts Supply Chain (SPS) is the single service parts provider within Philips Healthcare. SPS is responsible for the total service parts supply chain from the factory/suppliers to the regions. The strategy is to maximize the service part availability, minimize the total cost of operation and minimize the inventory level. To realize this strategy, SPS operates a global service parts network, including supply management, strategic planning, supply chain execution systems, forward Logistics (warehouse/distribution), Business Partner Management, reverse logistics and IT tools. To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Software Engineering or equivalent. 8+ years) Hands-on experience in programming (asp.NET, C#, javascript, SQL, etc.) and Oracle databases, especially for workflow applications. Supply Chain knowledge. Experience in software validation preferred. Experience in AI implementation preferred. Able to work on multiple projects at once at both an individual and team level. Result oriented, persuasive, encouraging and motivating. Fluent in English (verbal and written). Strong communication and presentation skills, and ability to interact effectively with colleagues on management and leadership level. Proven global skills; experience in a cross-cultural environment teamwork. Good prioritization skills, keeping what is most important to the success of the business always in view. title: Shop Floor Controller
jobDescription:
Job Title Shop Floor Controller Job Description Location
- Chakan , Pune The Shop Floor Controller (SFC) is responsible for managing all SAP-related transactions associated with shop floor production orders. This includes order release, execution, and coordination with the warehouse for material issuance as per the shift plan. The role involves ensuring accurate documentation flow (POP or system documents) to the shop floor and resolving any work order costing or variance issues through close coordination with the Production Planner, Production Manager, and Finance team. The SFC plays a key role in ensuring seamless production execution, accurate system transactions, and compliance with operational policies and procedures. Your

ROLE:
Assist in generating a feasible Detailed Production Schedule (DPS) from the Master Production Schedule (MPS), with a focus on minimizing changeover times in coordination with Production and Operations Management. Collaborate with the Production Manager to release production schedules and production orders to the shop floor. Participate in daily and/or weekly planning meetings with Production and Operations teams to ensure alignment, address constraints, and resolve issues proactively. Execute and monitor all SAP transactions related to production orders, including order release, confirmations, material consumption, and order closure. Communicate with the Warehouse team for timely issuance and availability of materials as per shift plans. Troubleshoot and resolve costing or variance issues related to work orders by collaborating closely with the Planner, Production Manager, and Finance team. Support in material issuance execution for all production orders; escalate discrepancies or issues promptly. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all SAP entries and documentation related to shop floor activities. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and system utilization on the shop floor. Maintain compliance with all company policies, safety standards, and operational guidelines. You are the right fit if you have: Any graduate or Diploma with 2–5 years of experience in a manufacturing or shop floor control role, preferably in an SAP environment. Strong understanding of SAP Production Planning (PP) module and related transactions (Order Release, Confirmation, Goods Issue, Goods Receipt). Good analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Production, Planning, Warehouse, and Finance). High attention to detail, accuracy, and a commitment to operational excellence. Job Title Clinical Data Partnerships & Acquisition Lead Job Description Clinical Data Partnerships & Acquisition Lead We are seeking a senior clinical professional to enable and accelerate clinical data acquisition for the Data & AI organization. This role operates within the defined data-chain RACI and focuses on removing bottlenecks across site onboarding, clinical alignment, and data acquisition workflows. The incumbent will act as a central orchestrator, ensuring alignment between clinical stakeholders, field teams, and internal Data & AI functions. The role works in close partnership with field application specialists, clinical science teams, and partnerships teams to drive efficient and scalable data acquisition. Your

ROLE:
Role Scope & Operating Model Direct Accountability Orchestrate end-to-end data acquisition workflow readiness and execution Identify, track, and resolve key bottlenecks in the data acquisition lifecycle Ensure alignment between clinical requirements and data/AI needs Drive workflow initiation and tracking in contracting tools (e.g., Orion) Delivered in Partnership This role works in collaboration with: Field Application Specialists – protocol execution, site operations Clinical Science (BU & Field) – study design, validation Clinical Partnerships Leader / Market teams – site relationships Data & AI teams – data requirements, dataset usability External engagement with hospitals is conducted through these partner teams Key Responsibilities
1. Clinical Data Acquisition Enablement Enable identification and onboarding of clinical data sources in collaboration with field and clinical teams Support site feasibility and readiness discussions Accelerate data acquisition by removing process and coordination delays
2. Stakeholder Coordination & Clinical Interface Act as a central coordination point across clinical, field, and data teams Translate clinical needs into structured data requirements Support creation of datasets for: AI/ML model development Clinical validation Regulatory submissions Product performance analysis
3. Workflow & Process Orchestration Initiate and track workflows in site contracting tools (e.g., Orion) Ensure readiness and alignment of: Data collection criteria and case selection Clinical documentation requirements Coordinate (not independently execute): Protocol readiness (owned by Clinical Apps Specialists) Data preparation activities (annotation, classification, etc.)
4. Data Lifecycle Execution Enable and accelerate execution in collaboration with responsible owners: Site feasibility and selection Data Management Plan inputs Ethics and consent processes (IRB/IEC) Contracting and agreement discussions Ensure alignment across clinical, regulatory, and data/AI requirements
5. Governance, Compliance & Data Quality Ensure adherence to: Clinical protocols and study requirements Ethics and consent frameworks Privacy and regulatory standards Provide clinical inputs (in partnership) for: Data quality and usability Imaging/data standards Anonymization and metadata quality
6. Bottleneck Resolution & Operational Acceleration Identify and resolve bottlenecks across: Site onboarding Ethics and approval timelines Data readiness and usability Drive improvements aligned to the data-chain RACI Key Interfaces Internal Stakeholders Data Manager, Data Architects, AI/Data Science teams Clinical Science (BU & Field) Application Specialists Clinical Partnerships Leader Market / Sales Teams Legal, Privacy, Regulatory, IP&S External Stakeholders (via partnerships model) Hospitals and imaging centers Research institutions You Are a Great Fit If: Qualifications & Experience Education Advanced degree in Radiology, Clinical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, or related field Experience 10–15 years in: MR clinical domain / radiology workflows Clinical research or hospital engagement Data acquisition or clinical operations Domain Expertise MRI protocols and clinical workflows Clinical research processes (IRB/IEC, consent, study protocols) Hospital ecosystem and stakeholder engagement Healthcare data ecosystems (DICOM, PACS, EMR/EHR, RIS) Skills & Competencies Strong stakeholder management across clinical and technical teams Ability to translate clinical needs into data requirements Strong execution and problem-solving capability Cross-functional collaboration in global environments Knowledge of clinical data governance and privacy frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI/ML data programs or clinical data platforms Exposure to data lifecycle tools (e.g., Orion contracting workflows) Knowledge of synthetic data or federated learning approaches Success Metrics Reduction in data acquisition cycle time Improved workflow turnaround (e.g., Orion) Reduction in identified bottlenecks across lifecycle stages Improved data quality and usability How we work together: We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Simulation Expert (MRI systems)
jobDescription:
Job Title Simulation Expert (MRI systems) Job Description Simulation Expert (MRI systems) Your

ROLE:
Developing and applying computational models, mainly in electromagnetics (e.g. RF, EMC) and selectively across thermal, structural, and CFD domains, to guide MRI hardware R&D decisions. Translating system-and subsystem-level requirements into appropriate mathematical and computational models with the right level of fidelity Evaluating performance, safety, and reliability aspects through simulation and clearly communicating results and limitations Performing concept, feasibility, and trade‑off studies to guide design choices and technology development Ensuring model credibility, documentation, and traceability in line with internal standards and regulatory expectations Supporting system‑level insight by integrating models across multiple physics and engineering domains Planning and prioritizing modelling activities, estimating effort, and reporting progress to stakeholders Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure modelling results are actionable and aligned with project needs Staying up to date with advancements in modelling methods, simulation tools, and medical imaging technology Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to the capability growth of the HW Modelling team You Are a Great Fit If: A Master’s degree or Ph D in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline Should have 5+ years of industry experience in relevant areas. Strong hands-on experience with commercial simulation tools (e.g. Ansys, CST, Sim4Life, COMSOL, MATLAB Simscape/Simulink) Programming experience in MATLAB and/or Python for model development, automation, and analysis (C/C++ is a plus) Experience in medical technology, preferably MR R&D or a closely related domain A solid foundation in mechatronics, applied mathematics and physics, with the ability to understand, explain, and validate the underlying assumptions and limitations of simulation models Demonstrated research mindset, such as publications, workflow improvements, or new modelling techniques You will stand out if you also have: Proven ability to translate complex system-level challenges into computational and mathematical models Familiarity with AI- or data-enabled modelling approaches, including surrogate or reduced-order models Experience working in multidisciplinary, global R&D environments, engaging effectively with engineers, scientists, and stakeholders A proactive, innovative mindset with the ability to work independently while contributing strongly to team objectives Hands-on experience with RF transmit/receive coils and birdcage resonators or other MRI components How we work together: We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Platform System Engineer
jobDescription: Job Title Platform System Engineer Job Description The Systems Technologist is responsible for analyzing intricate technical requirements and executing all necessary steps for successful integrations between complex systems, prioritizing security, data integrity, and performance optimization, working under general supervision. The role defines and documents system-level technical specifications, translating business requirements into actionable plans. The role conducts impact assessments for new technologies or system changes by evaluating risks and devising effective mitigation strategies. The role presents findings and analysis to technical leadership and stakeholders, effectively communicating technical concepts and rationale to support system design decisions. Your Role As a Platform System Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, validating, deploying, and supporting enterprise IT infrastructure platforms that power healthcare imaging solutions, including PACS and Radiology Informatics systems. You will work closely with R&D, Product Engineering, Support, and Customer teams to ensure platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and operational excellence across customer environments. Key Responsibilities Design and maintain platform architectures for enterprise healthcare imaging solutions. Define infrastructure standards, deployment models, and system sizing recommendations. Evaluate new technologies and translate business requirements into technical solutions. Support virtualization, storage, networking, operating systems, and cloud platforms. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, performance, and reliability issues. Develop automation scripts and tools to improve infrastructure monitoring and usage analytics. Participate in platform validation, performance testing, and capacity planning. Drive platform security, system hardening, patching, and compliance activities. Collaborate with global cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. Support customer escalations, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. You're the Right Fit If Experience 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, System Administration, or Solution Architecture. Experience designing and supporting large-scale enterprise platforms. Experience working in global and cross-functional environments. Technical Skills Strong expertise in VMware v Sphere, ESXi, v Center, and virtualization technologies. Good understanding of Windows Server and Linux platforms. Strong knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, routing, switching, VPNs, and firewalls. Experience with enterprise storage technologies including SAN, NAS, and backup solutions. Experience with infrastructure monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. Hands-on scripting and automation experience using Power Shell and/or Python. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) is an advantage. Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity concepts. Healthcare & Product Knowledge Experience with Healthcare IT, Medical Imaging, PACS, RIS, VNA, DICOM, or HL7 is preferred. Understanding of enterprise software deployment and product lifecycle processes. Experience with system documentation, BOMs, validation documents, and traceability matrices. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation abilities. Job Title Commercial Finance Specialist Job Description Job title: Commercial Finance Specialist Job Description Summary The Credit and Collections Specialist is responsible for evaluating moderately complex credit and collections applications, guiding subordinates, managing a complex account portfolio, implementing process improvements, securing credit decisions, releasing blocked sales orders, coordinating with businesses on credit risk, and reporting disputed invoices to ensure effective credit management. The role manages a large portfolio, focusing on tailored solutions, effective client relationships, and high service levels. The role oversees accounts receivable lean process improvements, enhancing operational efficiency and data quality. The role supports optimization of the collection strategy and the process of disputes registration and cash application The role ensures timely release of blocked sales orders, reviews credit reports, and presents in risk committee meetings. Your

ROLE:
Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Evaluates moderately-complexity credit and collections applications by gathering and analyzing financial information and supporting the decision-making process with accurate data and recommendations. • Provides guidance to subordinates to complete assignments by adhering to established guidelines, procedures, and policies, ensuring that tasks are performed accurately and efficiently while maintaining compliance with organizational standards. • Manages a large portfolio with a moderately complex account base, focusing on delivering tailored solutions, maintaining effective client relationships, and ensuring high levels of service and satisfaction. • Ensures clients with past due balances are contacted to secure payment or payment commitments, follow up on jobDescription:
Job Title Interoperability Software Architect Job Description Interoperability Software Architect Lead the design and implementation of scalable, automation-driven testing strategies that ensure compliance with healthcare standards. The Interoperability Architect will drive interoperability test strategy with tactical realization, innovation in test infrastructure, collaborate across teams, and shape the future of interoperability verification through AI-supported approaches. Join us in advancing interoperability testing with AI-driven innovation and make a real impact on how systems connect and work together. Your

ROLE:
Evolve and enhance interoperability test strategy in collaboration with lead interoperability architect. Bridges strategic verification and tactical realization (how to test) of interoperability for BU products. Translate interoperability requirements into scalable automation strategy, minimizing duplication through common step patterns and reusable components. Ensure availability and scalability of test infrastructure, environment, and tooling, including integration with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based environments. Ensure coverage, consistency, and efficiency of testing processes to meet interoperability requirements. Establish metrics and KPIs to measure test effectiveness and interoperability coverage. Owns test execution infrastructure of the verification team. Lead innovation in testing, including transition from manual tests to Gherkin specifications, AI-supported test generation, and emerging methodologies. Supporting Interoperability Architects in deploying interoperability tests into BU CI/CD pipelines. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies in interoperability and testing. Collaborate with various stakeholders, including business units (BUs) and interoperability architects to align testing with business objectives and interoperability standards. Mentor and guide engineers in test architecture and automation best practices, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. You are fit if: 14+ experience in Software Development, Software Design and Architecture, Testing and Quality Assurance or equivalent. Strong understanding of interoperability standards and verification processes. Expertise in test automation frameworks and reusable component design. Proficiency in CI/CD tools and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP). Knowledge of behavior-driven development (BDD) and Gherkin syntax. Ability to architect and maintain scalable test infrastructure. Analytical skills to define and measure test coverage and effectiveness. Awareness of emerging technologies and trends in interoperability and testing. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Strategic thinking with the ability to translate requirements into tactical execution. How we work together: We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Electrical Designer
jobDescription:
Job Title Electrical Designer Job Description Electrical Designer As an Electronics Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing and developing electronic subsystems including computing platforms, user interfaces, displays, and EMC-compliant designs, for Philips Image Guided Therapy products. In this role, you will contribute to developing components and system elements using the V-model methodology while aligning with user needs, product requirements, and business objectives. You will apply internal and external research insights, leverage emerging technologies, and ensure robust system-level thinking throughout the design lifecycle. Your work will contribute directly to delivering high-quality, reliable, and innovative solutions that enhance performance and enable exceptional clinical experiences. Your

ROLE:
Develop specifications for various subsystems like PC’s, Displays, User interface etc. Creating and/or participating in design reviews and risk assessments (e.g. FMEA) Alignment with other functions (mechanical, mechatronics, norm compliance, test and validation, purchase, quality, other). Conducting early integration tests on predefined prototypes and addressing supplier issues will also be your responsibility. You will follow up on any necessary actions. Execute verification of units and parts according to your assignment, with expertise in EMC testing will be a plus. Your role will require performing all tasks in line with established department processes. Your role will require safety test specification (IEC60601-1) for sub-systems, Setup the test strategy and test plans to comply with international standards in alignment with the norm compliance department. Perform functional and compliance tests with documentation. Created requirements, Designed, developed and verified, released at least 1 sub-system of independently. You are a part of Infrastructure department in Mechatronic Development Cluster within the IGT Fixed Systems R&D organization. The department consists of an open and multi-cultural team working towards new product introductions (NPI) of image guided therapy system. You are fit if: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering or equivalent Minimum of 4+ years of relevant R&D working experience in medical domain. Experience in product design, development, and maintenance of released products. (preferable experience in IEC60601-1-2). Excellent design documentation skills. Result oriented and self-steering with a problem-solving attitude. Good Knowledge of Embedded Analog and Digital hardware design, experience in new product introduction or life-cycle development in a regulated industry Ability to work independently & to act proactively. Good command of English (both written and verbal). Work experience in Agile Release Trains following SAFe framework will be preferred. Quality mindset, A Six Sigma Green Belt will be a plus. Experience and knowledge of EMC in design and testing will be a plus. Experience in utilizing AI platforms and working with AI-driven tools would be a plus. Experience in user interface (UI) design and knowledge of UX principles for hardware/software integration will be an added advantage. Knowledge of FDA guidelines and compliance requirements for medical devices will be preferred. How we work together: We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Senior Software Technologist - C++
jobDescription:
Job Title Senior Software Technologist
- C++ Job Description Minimum required

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent. Job title: Senior Software Technologist Your

ROLE:
Own design, develop and test software components for patient monitoring within the interoperability and connectivity scope. This includes implementation of a framework to support third party device integration with our patient monitors. Analyze software, functional requirements to design and develop high‑quality software. Write efficient, maintainable code in C++ for embedded Linux systems following best practices and design patterns. Implement unit and component tests and develop automated test suites using Google Test (GTest) and Gherkin‑based BDD Participate in an international Scrum team and engage in Scrum rituals, collaborating closely with device interoperability experts, software developers, and architects. Adopt AI-enabled development tools and demonstrate measurable productivity improvements. Support software lifecycle management activities including documentation, sustaining engineering, defect resolution, and platform evolution. Optimize application performance by identifying and resolving bottlenecks in resource-constrained embedded Linux environments. You're the right fit if: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or related technical field. 10+ year experience in embedded Linux with hands-on with advanced C++ (17/20/23). Strong command of object-oriented programming, memory management, multithreading, and performance optimization. Good to have experience in Interoperability using HL7/FHIR/IEEE 11073 SDC in clinical environments. Experience with technical documentation, code reviews, and compliance with medical software development processes (e.g., IEC 62304). Experience with unit testing framework, Python, Gtest, Gherkin, and Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) for component testing and automation. Communication protocols
- TCP/UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, Web Sockets, RS-232 protocol. Security-by-design: Threat modelling, TLS, certificate management, vulnerability management. Tooling: Git, ADO/Git Hub, Visual Studio, VS Code, CMake, unit/integration testing, static/dynamic analysis. Nice to have: g RPC/Protobuf, MQTT, Python for tooling/test harnesses, exposure to FDA/EU MDR expectations. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations. Indicate if this role is an office/field/onsite role. jobDescription:
Job Title Product Industrialization Project Manager Job Description In this role, you have the opportunity to prove your strengths in product industrialization and grow in multi-disciplinary Team/Project Management. You will focus on Product Industrialization. Driving operational finesse, efficiency, availability, quality and lead-time and developing long-term plans to support business expectations. Other key areas are building Design for Manufacturing (DFM)/ Design for Supply Chain Management (Df SCM) processes, technology roadmaps, core/non-core assessments, make-or-buy decisions, CAPEX investments, customizations strategies, first-time-right NPI and establishing a culture of continuous improvement. Your

ROLE:
Project Management of all work to meet Schedule, Cost, and Quality Requirements Balancing multiple interdependencies and business risks related to product introduction activities Ensuring optimum process capability, alignment to quality standards, and Df MAT (design for manufacturability, assembly and test) best practices are leveraged Leading and cooperating with an Operations project team including engineering, procurement, quality, logistics, catalog management and manufacturing Representing Operations in the integral project team and acting as Single Point of Contact between Operations and the cross- functional project team Identifying and Driving manufacturing/engineering/value chain improvements during product development projects & transfer projects and drive product improvements with regard to variety, cost, quality and failure rate, implementing Df MAT principles Identifying the impact of new products on the current supply chain architecture and manufacturing concepts in order to develop the required architecture and solutions, initiate the deployment and define guidelines and complete implementation Being responsible for the implementation in the supply chain of project related Engineering Changes Cooperate with partners to define concepts of new products with efficient landed costs Driving make/buy decisions and be involved in supplier selection process Driving operational excellence of project execution to achieve first time right predictable project execution Investigating, improving & deploying procedures related to Product Industrialization Key performance indicators -Cost of Non Quality (CONQ) -Initial Product Quality: DEFOA -Customer supply chain lead-time -Deliver NPI as per plan -FCP index -Capex TFA -Procurement BOM savings -Field change orders & recalls You are a part of The Business Image Guided Therapy System (IGTS). We deliver medical systems and solutions that are based on the usage of X-ray. Within this Business the Product Industrialization department is responsible for developing and releasing the manufacturing process for new products considering people, quality, processes, tools and the performance of production execution from order to installation, with the purpose to establish faster, better and cheaper realization processes in order to achieve outstanding results.You will report into the Product Industrialization Leader of IGTS and work closely together with engineering, procurement, logistics, quality, supply chain, catalog development and manufacturing. You're the right fit if you have: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field. 10+ years of experience in Product Industrialisation, NPI, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Project Management. Proven track record leading complex cross-functional projects in regulated industries. Experience driving NPI, LCM, product transfers, and engineering changes across global manufacturing sites. Strong stakeholder, risk, issue, and change management skills. Excellent communication, documentation, and leadership capabilities. Medical Device experience preferred; Aerospace, Automotive, or similar regulated industries considered. Key Skills: Proven experience in NPI, LCM, and Product Industrialisation of complex electro-mechanical products in a regulated manufacturing environment Complex project leadership Global manufacturing exposure Stakeholder and change management Risk mitigation and execution excellence Experience in regulated, high-complexity environments Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. title: Global Sales enablement & Commercial manager
jobDescription:
Job Title Global Sales enablement & Commercial manager Job Description Job Title: Global Sales Enablement & Commercial manager Your

ROLE:
Leads global CS & install base replacement business Leads the operational execution of the service/sales funnel, ensuring visibility, accuracy, and health across all funnel stages using standardized CRM dashboards. Conducts recurring funnel health checks by segment and stage to identify stagnation, aging risks, and weak opportunities, triggering targeted actions to improve flow and conversion. Leads CRM opportunity management by: Ensuring full pipeline visibility and quality for services across multiple accounts or territories. Enforcing rigorous stage and forecast category progression, coaching others to align stage, probability, and forecast. Driving high CRM data hygiene and zero overdue discipline within the team, including timely updates of forecasts and activities. Embedding quality guidelines and KPIs into daily CRM usage, ensuring win/loss insights are consistently captured and leveraged. Challenging and validating that CRM reflects commercial reality, improving forecast accuracy for the wider team. Using CRM data to provide highly accurate and insightful forecasts to senior management, enabling sound business decisions. Analyzes funnel KPIs, including coverage ratios, conversion rates, velocity, and aging to identify gaps versus AOP targets and initiates corrective actions. Consolidates accurate monthly funnel-based service OIT forecasts (commit/upside) and proactively escalates at risk or stalled deals to leadership, ensuring informed decision making. Leverages win/loss insights to drive continuous improvement in funnel effectiveness and sales behavior. Runs disciplined service funnel cadence with opportunity owners to review priorities, funnel status, gaps and blockers, coach opportunity owners on next-best actions. Assigns actions, owners, and due dates to drive opportunity progression and tracks completion to ensure predictable execution. Collaborates with service, commercial, and operations teams to resolve blockers and strengthen end to end service delivery processes. Builds partnerships with key internal stakeholders to drive operational improvements, applying data driven insights to enhance customer value. Identifies operational risks in service opportunity execution and implements mitigating actions to maintain compliance and service quality standards. Coaches opportunity owners and junior team members in funnel discipline, CRM best practices, and data driven decision making to uplift overall team performance. You're the right fit if: Master’s degree with 8-15 years of related experience in commercial role Preferably Customer Services / Healthcare experience Experience in a global matrix organization Experience in managing commercial targets, pricing and strategies Experience in customer insight/business analytics/market intelligence in healthcare industry Proven track record in Lean / Continuous Improvement. Green Belt/ Black belt certification is a preference Travel domestic and International, as & when required Demonstrated experience leading and/or coaching others (e.g., team leadership, people management, mentoring), typically approx. 2 years within the overall experience. How we work together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. title: Lead Software Technologist - .Net Fullstack
jobDescription:
Job Title Lead Software Technologist
- .Net Fullstack Job Description Minimum required

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent. Job title: One sentence description of role Your

ROLE:
Technical Stewardship: Contribute to the architectural design and implementation of cloud-native application services running on our Kubernetes-based platform. Team Mentorship: Act as a technical guide for a cross-functional Scrum team, conducting deep-dive code reviews and fostering a culture of engineering excellence. Full-Stack Delivery: Drive the development of responsive web front-ends and robust backend APIs, ensuring seamless integration across the entire stack. Quality Engineering: Apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) and other modern engineering practices to ensure application code is correct, stable, and maintainable before it reaches production. Build and maintain automated test suites (unit, integration, contract, end-to-end) to support rapid, safe delivery. Infrastructure Awareness: Collaborate with platform engineers to adopt platform capabilities and ensure smooth deployments through CI/CD pipelines. Dev Ops Mindset: Embrace a “you build it, you run it” approach by leveraging observability tooling and cloud-native patterns to maintain reliable services in production. Data Strategy: Design and optimize data models across SQL and No SQL databases Sets quality goals and development practices with the team, driving continuous improvement and excellence in software development through rigorous standards and methodologies. Coordinates code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices to maintain code quality. Analyzes and optimizes application performance, identifying and resolving bottlenecks to enhance user experience and system efficiency, ensuring the software meets performance benchmarks. title: Technical Supply Chain Project Manager
jobDescription:
Job Title Technical Supply Chain Project Manager Job Description The Supply Chain Project Manager is responsible for executing medium-scale supply chain projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations while managing specifications, timelines, budgets, and resources, working under limited supervision. The role employs an outcome-driven approach and evaluates the business case throughout the project lifecycle to maximize benefits and enhance business impact. The role cultivates strategic partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, aligns project goals with organizational strategy, integrates customer expectations, and ensures solutions contribute to elevated customer satisfaction. Your

ROLE:
Executes medium-scale supply chain projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations, while meticulously managing specifications, timelines, budgets, and resources, working under limited supervision and applies intermediate understanding of entrepreneurial skills in daily work. Articulates precise project scope, objectives, and deliverables through comprehensive stakeholder engagement and meticulous requirement analysis to ensure clarity and alignment from inception. Evaluates the business case throughout the project lifecycle, employing an outcome-driven approach to maximize benefits and enhance business impact within the supply chain domain. Guides and empowers cross-functional project teams, fostering a collaborative environment and enabling team members to achieve operational excellence, streamline processes, and achieve project milestones efficiently. Cultivates strategic partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, leveraging relationships to align project goals with organizational strategy, influence stakeholder perspectives, and negotiate effective solutions. Integrates customer expectations and feedback into project strategies, ensuring solutions are customer-centric and contribute to elevating customer satisfaction and loyalty within supply chain operations. Handles project activities rigorously, proactively addressing risks, issues, and dependencies while providing comprehensive progress reports and escalating critical issues promptly to project steering teams. Ensures adherence to Philips' global standards and best practices throughout project execution, including compliance with Philips Business System (PBS) and local Management System guidelines, to uphold quality and operational excellence. Analyzes project performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs), leveraging data-driven insights to optimize project delivery, mitigate risks effectively, and drive continuous improvement initiatives within the supply chain function. Documents and communicates project progress comprehensively, ensuring accurate documentation of project phases, decisions, and outcomes to facilitate knowledge sharing, compliance, and ongoing improvement within Philips' supply chain operations. You're the right fit if: Bachelor's degree in Engineering required. PMP certification required; Philips PM Foundation Certification preferred. 10+ years of Technical Project/Program Management experience in medical device, manufacturing, or complex engineering environments. Proven experience leading global cross-functional projects involving Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality functions. Strong engineering foundation with the ability to lead and coordinate mechanical, electrical/electronics, and software-related projects. Confident and assertive leader with the ability to influence, challenge, and engage senior stakeholders in a matrix organization. Demonstrated experience managing project risks, escalations, issue resolution, governance, and project documentation. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills with experience working across global teams. Self-driven, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Strong problem-solving skills with a hands-on, results-oriented mindset. jobDescription:
Job Title Learning Services Delivery Specialist-MRI Job Description Learning Services Delivery Specialist-MRI You are responsible for leading the delivery of advanced technical training programs for MRI Field Service Engineers and Installers across multiple regions and learning environments. The role ensures a consistent, high-quality learning experience that enables service personnel to safely install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support Philips MRI systems throughout their lifecycle. As a senior training professional, the Learning Services Delivery Specialist serves as the primary delivery expert for complex MRI technical curricula, utilizing deep product knowledge and advanced facilitation skills to translate sophisticated technical concepts into effective learning experiences. The role actively coaches learners, mentors junior trainers, and collaborates with engineering and business stakeholders to encourage improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing learning service delivery effectiveness, delivery capacity, and learner performance. Unlike content development-focused positions, this role emphasizes training delivery, learner engagement, curriculum execution, and capability building. Content creation activities are limited to maintaining, refining, and updating existing training materials to reflect engineering changes, field feedback, and business priorities. Your

ROLE:
Training Delivery & Facilitation Lead delivery of advanced instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, and blended MRI technical training programs for Field Service Engineers and Installers. Facilitate complex technical courses covering MRI safety, installation, site readiness, acceptance testing, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, software applications, and system performance optimization, while taking the increasing digitalization of MRI service operations into acocunt. Create engaging learning experiences using adult learning principles, practical demonstrations, simulations, and hands-on laboratory exercises. Adapt instructional methods to different learner audiences, experience levels, and regional requirements while maintaining global training standards. Serve as a recognized technical training expert and trusted advisor for learners and stakeholders. Learner Development & Coaching Assess learner performance and provide coaching to improve technical competency and field readiness. Mentor less experienced instructors and support their development in delivery excellence and facilitation techniques. Curriculum Execution & Continuous Improvement Execute established MRI curricula while ensuring training remains aligned with evolving product and service requirements. Review, update, and refine existing training materials based on engineering releases, product updates, field feedback, and training evaluations. Identify training gaps and provide recommendations for curriculum improvements. Analyze learner feedback, assessment results, and operational performance indicators to improve training effectiveness. Support implementation of new delivery methodologies, technologies, and learning solutions. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Service Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, and Service Operations teams to ensure training remains technically accurate and operationally relevant. Act as a key point of contact for regional service organizations regarding MRI service training needs. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to support successful delivery of training programs. Support customer-facing education initiatives when required. Operational Excellence Coordinate training schedules, laboratory availability, equipment readiness, and delivery logistics. Ensure compliance with Philips quality, regulatory, safety, and audit requirements. Support standardization of learning delivery processes across global training locations. Lead small-to-medium improvement projects focused on enhancing learning service effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability. Provide constructive feedback and individualized development guidance to learners. Drive knowledge transfer and capability building across the global MRI service organization. You are fit if: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Education, Learning & Development, Training Management, Healthcare Technology, or equivalent. Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training delivery, or field service, healthcare technology, medical imaging, or a related technical environment. Preferred Experience servicing and/or installing MRI systems. Experience delivering training in a technical, regulated, or healthcare environment. Knowledge of MRI hardware, software, networking, and service workflows. Experience working with global training programs and multicultural audiences. Familiarity with virtual learning environments, simulation-based learning, and blended learning approaches. Experience mentoring instructors, facilitators, or technical experts. Knowledge of quality management systems and compliance requirements within healthcare technology organizations. Demonstrated experience delivering instructor-led technical training to adult learners. Travel: 20–30% globally, as required for training delivery, workshops, and business support. How we work together: We believe that we are better together than apart. title: Senior Test Architect
jobDescription:
Job Title Senior Test Architect Job Description Your Role The Test Architect is technically-focused — ensuring the testing ecosystem (strategy, frameworks, tools, pipelines) is robust, scalable, and compliant by design and market standards. Owns test strategy, tooling decisions, framework design and automation vision. Accountable for quality and engineering excellence (Craftsmanship). Analyses defect patterns (root-cause, clustering by module/device); recommends systemic fixes Attends standup as needed; advises on technical blockers, environment issues or framework gaps. Authors and maintains the overarching Test Strategy document (risk-based, model-based, exploratory); defines coverage models, test levels (unit → system → acceptance), and device/OS matrix for mobiles. Defines quality attributes & KPIs (code coverage thresholds, mutation score, static-analysis rules); designs guardrails in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., blocking merge on test failure). Architects the test suite to be comprehensive enough to catch issues pre-release; designs shift-left practices (contract tests, API-level validation) to reduce late-found defects. Participate in feature design review to understand testability and failure mode reviews. Designs parallelized test execution, test data management, smart test selection (impact analysis), and optimized CI pipelines to reduce duration. Owns the AI & automation architecture: framework selection, layer split (UI vs API vs unit), mobile-specific tooling (Appium/Detox/Espresso/XCUITest), and maintainability standards. Defines the branching strategy (e.g., Git Flow, trunk-based with feature flags); sets up automated smoke/regression suites that gate RC promotion; ensures test environments mirror branch structure. Mentors testers on technical skills (automation, tooling, medical domain nuances); sets coding standards for test code; defines architecture of automation. Represent Cross Functional (PH/PIC Mobile)Architect forum to bring in learnings to drive best practices in OHC.
